mapper.select: SELECT ID AS BIZID, MEMBER_ID, TYPE, BIZNO, NAME, CEO, PHONE, ZIPCODE, ADDR1, ADDR2, STATUS, APPROVED, CREATED FROM BUSINESS WHERE STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY CREATED DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BUSINESS ( MEMBER_ID, TYPE, BIZNO, NAME, CEO, PHONE, ZIPCODE, ADDR1, ADDR2, STATUS, CREATED ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{type}, #{bizNo}, #{name}, #{ceo}, #{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{zipcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{addr1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{addr2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, SYSDATE )
